files.luhn.py:
import re


def luhn_valid(number):
    cleaned = re.sub(r"[ -]", "", number)
    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{12,19}", cleaned) is None:
        return False
    nums = [int(c) for c in cleaned]
    odd = sum(nums[-1::-2])
    even = sum(sum(divmod(d * 2, 10)) for d in nums[-2::-2])
    return (odd + even) % 10 == 0
